findings.summary: The Ohm-law worked-example title was a literal and unnatural rendering of finding current.
evidence: The previous title was Aktuelles finden, which does not mean determining electrical current naturally in German.

findings.summary: The electrical-power heading used Energie instead of the technical term Leistung.
evidence: The previous title was Elektrische Energie while the section defines P and discusses measured power.

findings.summary: The TCR example title used hitziger, which sounds colloquial and person-like rather than technical.
evidence: The previous title was Ein hitziger Widerstand.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Ein erwärmter Widerstand.
